$comment: Each feature's expected surfaces, read by tools/scripts/check-feature-surfaces.js, which documents the format. Built from the features shipped 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09; a new feature adds its entry in the pull request that ships its first surface. A gap names what is missing; `unclaimed` lists surfaces that belong to no feature, each with the reason.
